note: Milliseconds, median of 5 runs in Vitest browser mode (Chromium), measured by src/test/performance.test.ts. Each budget is about 3x the median of three suite runs on the shared development host (25 ms floor), never above the previous budget, so a 2x slowdown fails while CI retry absorbs noise. The CI runner measures the same file about 2.5-3.5x slower than the host and that ratio moves from run to run, so on CI (process.env.CI) every budget is multiplied by ciFactor; a 1.5x regression still fails there. mount = first render + layout; update = the change named in the scenario + layout. A scenario's name says what it renders: lazy-50 and collapsed mean the component draws only that part of the data.
